commentary: Revenue for August came in at [[revenue.month.actual]], above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), but direct costs of [[direct_costs.month.actual]] ran higher than budget by [[direct_costs.month.vs_budget]] ([[direct_costs.month.vs_budget_pct]]), leaving gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], below budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]] and down on last year by [[gross_margin.month.vs_py_pp]]. Operating profit for August was [[operating_profit.month.actual]], below budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and slightly down on last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]).
